message.content: {"hts_code": "5903.90.2500", "reason": "The fabric is woven textile coated with visible polyurethane plastic, so it is classified in heading 5903 as a textile fabric coated with plastics, of man-made staple fibers."
message.reasoning: This is a classic ruling — coated fabric visible to naked eye, plastic-coated textile, chapter 59, woven upholstery fabric. Since coating visible, classified as coated fabric 5903.90, but if coating accounts... Actually visible coating means not chapter 56/59? Visible to naked eye → classified as coated fabric of 5903. Polyurethane coating 63.4% > textile? Coating weight exceeds fiber weight, but visible coating means not considered plastics chapter 39. 5903.90.25? Woven, of man-made staple fibers... 5903.90.25 covers other, of man-made fibers? Actually 5903.90.25: other coated textile fabrics, of man-made fibers. Ruling style Dillion 2.0 TR — NY ruling classified 5903.90.2500? I recall 5903.90.25.0.
